verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an open-source self-hosted deployment where you "own the stack, the data, and every component" via a Docker-based REST server and dashboard, satisfying the self-hosting/no-cloud-infra part of the story. However, no evidence describes running it embedded in-process (as a library) or configuring it against local LLMs/embedding models, and the Platform features (graph memory, advanced retrieval) are explicitly cloud-hosted. Missing for 10: evidence of in-process/library-only embedding, explicit local-model (no external API) configuration, and confirmation that self-hosted mode has no residual cloud dependency for embeddings/LLM calls.
